analyst.summary: Borosil Renewables makes solar glass for India's booming renewables sector and has recently turned a corner: it exited a loss-making German unit, benefits from a new anti-dumping duty on Chinese and Vietnamese solar glass, and has approved a 50% capacity expansion in Gujarat. The most recent quarter was genuinely strong (31% operating margin), but this follows several inconsistent, loss-making years, and the stock has already re-rated to reflect the improvement. We rate it a Hold: real tailwinds, but a valuation that now assumes the good times continue and a policy (anti-dumping duty) that is not guaranteed to stay in place indefinitely.
